_comment: Model descriptions Jev chooses between (policy.models[*].good_at/weak_at/cost). Jev never sees names or numbers; these words are the whole basis of its pick. Sources: Artificial Analysis API per-task columns (hard reasoning, terminal/agentic, coding, long context, speed) at the effort each model really runs here, joined with OpenRouter price/window, plus warslop gates of 2026-10-20/21. Domain study questions (science, medicine, law) use Vals AI and AA domain benchmarks. Writing and Indonesian quality are not ranked (every model does them); small talk and summaries go to the free pool in the app. Cost words: OpenCode Go models are included in a flat subscription; OpenRouter models are pay per use.

ocgoa/opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash.good_at: very fast answers, long documents and long conversations (the best long-context reasoning), everyday coding and tool use, solid reasoning; solid on science, medical and legal study questions
ocgoa/opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash.weak_at: the toughest multi-step tool tasks, where the 1017 build and glm are stronger; legal research a step behind glm

ocgoa/opencode-go/qwen3.8-flash.good_at: coding (the best coding-index score among the cheap models) and science exam questions (top science-exam score), general tasks, reads images
ocgoa/opencode-go/qwen3.8-flash.weak_at: formal proofs and long derivations, long multi-step tool tasks and the hardest reasoning; no measured strength on medical or legal questions; moderate speed

ocgob/opencode-go/gpt-6-luna.good_at: a different vendor as a fallback when the others fail
ocgob/opencode-go/gpt-6-luna.weak_at: tool use, hard reasoning, coding, legal research and scientific work (at the effort it runs here it is near the bottom on all of them); do not choose it for these

ocgob/opencode-go/glm-5.3-flash.good_at: coding, debugging, data work and long multi-step tool use (top tier on terminal-task and coding benchmarks); among the strongest cheap models for study questions in science, medicine and law (science-exam, medical-note and legal-research results); reads images; moderate speed
ocgob/opencode-go/glm-5.3-flash.weak_at: the fastest answers (it thinks before it answers)

ocpv/opencode-go/longcat-2.5-preview-fre.good_at: simple requests when nothing else answers
ocpv/opencode-go/longcat-2.5-preview-fre.weak_at: very slow to start answering; weak at reasoning and tools

ocgob/opencode-go/mimo-v2.6-flash.good_at: simple factual questions and light tasks; reads images; passable on basic science
ocgob/opencode-go/mimo-v2.6-flash.weak_at: coding, tool use, hard reasoning and legal research (clearly behind the others); slow to start

openrouter/z-ai/glm-5.3-flash.good_at: coding, debugging, data work and long multi-step tool use (top tier on terminal-task and coding benchmarks); among the strongest cheap models for study questions in science, medicine and law (science-exam, medical-note and legal-research results); reads images; quick to start
openrouter/z-ai/glm-5.3-flash.weak_at: the fastest answers (it thinks before it answers)

openrouter/anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5.good_at: a different vendor as a fallback when the others fail; with long thinking it is strong on legal research, medical notes and science analysis, but it runs quick here
openrouter/anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5.weak_at: tool use and hard reasoning at the effort it runs here (well below the deepseek and glm models)

openrouter/openai/gpt-6-luna.good_at: a different vendor as a fallback when the others fail
openrouter/openai/gpt-6-luna.weak_at: tool use, hard reasoning, coding, legal research and scientific work at the effort it runs here; do not choose it for these

ocpv/opencode-go/minimax-m3.1-flash-free.good_at: the strongest free option at hard reasoning, coding and multi-step tool use, and the best free choice for hard science, medical and legal study questions; reads images; summaries of long text
ocpv/opencode-go/minimax-m3.1-flash-free.weak_at: sometimes mixes Chinese words into Indonesian answers

ocpv/opencode-go/beam-free.good_at: small talk, greetings, short factual answers and summaries of short or medium text; the fastest to answer
ocpv/opencode-go/beam-free.weak_at: tool use, code, hard reasoning, and legal or medical questions beyond the basics (low legal-research score)

openrouter/minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash:fr.good_at: the strongest free option at hard reasoning, coding and multi-step tool use, and the best free choice for hard science, medical and legal study questions; reads images; summaries of long text
openrouter/minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash:fr.weak_at: sometimes mixes Chinese words into Indonesian answers

openrouter/nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-.good_at: following instructions exactly, summaries, short factual answers, science exam questions and simple code in clean Indonesian
openrouter/nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-.weak_at: hard reasoning, long tool tasks, code and especially legal research (a very low score); can be slow on long answers

openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-.good_at: the strongest all-rounder here: hard reasoning and maths, difficult coding, long multi-step tool and terminal tasks, long documents, and the best choice for hard science, medical and legal study questions (top hard-reasoning and scientific-coding scores, the best legal-research score among the cheap models); still fast; reads images
openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-.weak_at: pay per use, so only when the included models are not enough

openrouter/inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash.good_at: fast, cheap tool use and long documents (top-tier terminal-task and long-context results for its price), everyday coding and reasoning
openrouter/inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash.weak_at: hard reasoning; legal and medical questions (its family scores at the bottom on legal research and medical tests); does not read images; shorter memory (about a quarter of a million tokens)
